sentences.text: Shri Navnidhi Parharya - Advocate for revisionist.

Dr. Anjali Gyanani - Public Prosecutor for respondent
 State.

Order 
This criminal revision under Section 397 read with Section 401 of Cr.P.C. has been filed against the order dated 13.04.2024 passed by Fifth Additional Sessions Judge, Shivpuri in S.T. No. 222/2020 and charges under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 read with Section 120-B of IPC have been framed.
2. In view of the fact that large quantity of incriminating articles were seized from the house of applicant, counsel for applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this revision.

3. Accordingly, with liberty to the applicant to raise all the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:5790 2 CRR-2443-2024 defences which may be available to him in trial, this revision is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE AK/-
